description: North Island 10m Pre-Cyclone Gabrielle Satellite Imagery Index Tiles (2022) is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Imagery. Index Tiles ONLY, for actual orthophotos see layer North Island 10m Pre-Cyclone Gabrielle Satellite Imagery (2022) This imagery was captured by the European Space Agency Sentinel-2 satellites on the 22nd November 2022 NZT. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher National Imagery. Its tags are imageryBaseMapsEarthCover. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2023-02-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
